senses.sense_definition: A loud shout or expression of strong approval or praise.

examples.text: The crowd greeted the returning hero with a thunderous <w>acclamation</w>.
The proposal was accepted by <w>acclamation</w> from the entire audience.

senses.sense_definition: An oral vote taken without a formal ballot, usually showing overwhelming support.

examples.text: The committee chose the new leader by <w>acclamation</w> during the meeting.
The motion passed by <w>acclamation</w> as no one opposed the decision.

senses.sense_definition: The act of winning an election automatically because there are no other candidates.

examples.text: She secured the position by <w>acclamation</w> since she was the only candidate.
The board members were elected by <w>acclamation</w> at the annual conference.

senses.sense_definition: A depiction in art or on medals of people showing joy or praise.

examples.text: The ancient coin features an <w>acclamation</w> scene celebrating the emperor.
Historians study the <w>acclamation</w> depicted on the bronze relief.
